## 1. Introduction
This guide serves as a comprehensive semantic layer for the "superhero" database, providing authoritative definitions, metric formulations, and governance standards. import pandas as pd

# Read superhero.csv
superhero_df = pd.read_csv('csv/superhero.csv')

# Read colour.json and flatten the 'records' column
colour_data = pd.read_json('json/colour.json')
colour_df = pd.json_normalize(colour_data['records'])
colour_df.rename(columns={'id': 'colour_id'}, inplace=True)

# Merge the two dataframes
merged_df = pd.merge(superhero_df, colour_df, left_on='eye_colour_id', right_on='colour_id', how='left')

# Find Karen Beecher-Duncan's eye colour
karen_beecher_duncan = merged_df[merged_df['full_name'] == 'Karen Beecher-Duncan']

if not karen_beecher_duncan.empty:
    eye_colour = karen_beecher_duncan['colour'].iloc[0]
    print(eye_colour)
else:
    print('Superhero not found or eye colour not available.')
